name: print-social-green-your-headline-post-with-arrow-shaped-white-panel
title: Lime-accented post with an arrow-shaped white panel over a café portrait
whatItIs: A square post with a darkened photo of a curly-haired woman smiling at a café table, a white panel with a pointed arrow edge holding a logo and 'YOUR HEADLINE GOES HERE' with 'HEADLINE' in lime, a lime 'Contact us' pill with arrow, and a footer row with website, social icons and phone.
whatItMeans: Clean and directive; the arrow panel points from message to person.
techniques: Shape the text panel as an arrow pointing at the subject.
Darken the photo for a moody base.

vocabulary.definition: A text box with a pointed edge.
